votar.title: Who Has More Aura? — Aura Duels | Farmear Aura
votar.description: Pick who has more aura. The winner steals aura points from the other one. Vote and watch the live ranking.
votar.sub: Pick one. The winner steals aura from the other.
votar.seo_p: Every character starts with 1,000 aura. When you vote, the winner steals points from the loser: beat someone with more aura and you steal more; beat someone who was already low and you barely take anything. Points update instantly and are the same for everyone who votes, so the ranking gets built entirely by people voting. Yes, you can end up negative.
votar.seo_link: Want to know how much aura you actually have? Take the aura test.
